name: qwen2_moe_fp8_router_experts_shuffled_16x16_model_dim2048_n_routed512_inter_dim128
description: sglang's Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock._forward_router_experts on one rank of its TP group, the shared expert fused into the experts after the routed ones: the logits hidden_states router_weight^T, rounded to bf16, pick each token's topk experts by descending logit, a tie going to the lower expert id, weighed by the softmax of their logits (the softmax over every expert, renormalized over the chosen ones), and the shared expert by sigmoid(hidden_states shared_gate_weight^T); each expert is down(silu(gate(x)) * up(x)) of fp8 weights at a scale per 128 x 128 block, each of its two linears taking its input as the checkpoint's FP8 scheme quantizes it: in bf16, then each 1 x 128 group in fp8 at a scale of its amax / 448; out is this rank's share of the block's output, which the TP group sums after the call.

n_experts.description: Expert slots: the routed experts, then the shared one.

inter_dim.description: Expert intermediate size on this rank.

gate_up_rows.description: w1 rows: gate and up concatenated.

hidden_states.description: The tokens' hidden states, the MoE block's input.

shared_gate_weight.description: shared_expert_gate's weight: the shared expert weighs sigmoid(hidden_states shared_gate_weight^T).

w1.description: Gate-up projection per expert slot on this rank: gate rows, then up rows.

w1_scale.description: w1's dequant scale per 128 x 128 block.

w2.description: Down projection per expert slot on this rank.

w2_scale.description: w2's dequant scale per 128 x 128 block.

out.description: This rank's share of the MoE block's output.
